information.common: history_flow, static/node graph information, history and independent forecast clock; shared context projection and whole-node LayerNorm
information.M0: forward(history,clock); D and age constructed as constant zeros internally
information.M2: forward(history,clock,D,age); age scaled by fixed 5 minutes and broadcast to every node
information.context: MLP([embedded last history, shared forecast calendar embeddings, D, age/5]); LayerNorm(last+context); no candidate output mask
information.removed: old ICSF, TIID, K, V, all pretrained A weights
information.capacity: same nominal shapes and initialization; report structurally inactive input-column weights, including constant D0; no claim of equal effective capacity
information.availability: report location available at first report remains conditional; matched controls receive paired pseudo-event D/age and their own calendar; these are stress tests, not naturally reported accidents

training.objective: all-node all-12-horizon valid-cell pooled standardized MAE on incident_full fit only
training.selection: lowest selection incident_full all-node pooled raw MAE; strict improvement, earlier epoch wins ties; epoch0 not a candidate
training.budget: 9 fresh full-backbone fits, 60 epochs each, 190 Adam steps per epoch = 102600 total steps; no early stopping or hyperparameter search

scaler: new unique station/nominal-slot fit X only; verify duplicates; finite nonnegative, real zero valid; fail if any node has no fit history; no old scaler or Y fallback

evaluation.primary: audit incident_full candidate_early H1-H6 pooled raw MAE gain: previous arm minus added-information arm
evaluation.secondary: equal-window MAE; all regions and matched positive/primary/secondary pseudo-event cohorts; all seeds separately
evaluation.gate: For each incremental comparison, all 3 seeds require primary relative gain >=1%, positive 95% week and 4-week-block CI lower bounds, and <=1% point harm in all-node/noncandidate incident_full and all four regions of both pseudo-event controls. Also require matched incident primary point gain positive. Otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED or INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT; no best seed. This is a strict development screen, not simultaneous 95% confidence or equivalence.

bootstrap.calendar: continuous 9-week audit grid; same draws for all seeds/arms/cohorts; cluster matched triples by positive origin week; pointwise conditional inference on reused development

pilot.purpose: GPU full-backbone cost/gradient check only; no model or threshold tuning from pilot errors

recovery: sealed atomic epoch snapshots including current/best weights, Adam, scheduler, training history and torch RNG; source read-only, destination new; identical protocol/input/code/device identity

boundaries.train_file_hash: hashing complete train files includes all unparsed future/held-out bytes; all-train metadata is used for identity/eligibility only

decision: one prespecified development comparison; review all outcomes; no automatic new modules, test access or promotion
